## Release template

Use this template when drafting a release on GitHub. Fill in the sections below with details about the release.

### Summary
A short summary of changes in this release.

### Highlights
- Important changes, new features, or breaking changes.

### Bug fixes
- List of notable bug fixes.

### Maintenance
- Dependency updates, performance improvements, other maintenance tasks.

### Migration / Upgrade notes
- Any steps users must take to upgrade.

### Contributors
Thanks to everyone who contributed: @contributors
